# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple 26.0 backport**

## Highlights

Backports the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs, plus a WinUI packaging fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 support backported** — Brings the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app target framework monikers to the 3.119.x servicing line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI projection DLL resolved for .NET 9** — Fixes a missing WinUI projection DLL that .NET 9 consumers hit at runtime. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
